landing.title: Cold-chain compliance AI for the Gulf
landing.subtitle: Automate inspection of temperature logs, QC forms, chat messages, and voice notes — grounded in GCC food-safety law. Every training label from a deterministic rules engine, never from an LLM.
landing.value1Body: Maps to Gulf Standardization Organization food-safety frameworks and jurisdiction-specific instruments (SFDA, ESMA, MoPH Qatar, and more).
landing.value2Body: Every record carries wave, cell, rules-engine hash, and screener verdict — built for HACCP cold-chain audits and traceability.
landing.value3Body: Gate A/B KPIs score corpus quality before training spend. Rescore existing data in one command without regenerating.
landing.value4Body: English and Arabic artifacts with authenticity scoring — designed for how GCC logistics teams actually communicate.
landing.jurisdictions: SA · AE · QA · BH · KW · OM
landing.seoTitle: GCC Cold-Chain Compliance AI | GSO Food Safety
landing.seoDesc: AI-assisted cold-chain compliance for GCC food operators. GSO-aligned, rules-engine labels, Gate A/B quality gates.
